programme.title: Angel
programme.desc: 1984. Thriller. Director: Robert Vincent O'Neil. Stars Cliff Gorman, Susan Tyrrell & Dick Shawn. Molly earns her living as a prostitute but a serial killer is targeting people in her profession.

programme.title: White Corridors
programme.desc: 1951. Drama. Directed by Pat Jackson. Stars Googie Withers, James Donald & Petula Clark. An insightful story about the day to day activities within Yeoman's Hospital during the early 1950s.

programme.title: Dentist In The Chair
programme.desc: 1960. Comedy. Stars Bob Monkhouse, Peggy Cummins, Kenneth Connor. A burglar breaks into the wrong shop and steals medical instruments instead of silver.

programme.title: House on Haunted Hill
programme.desc: 1959. Horror. Directed by William Castle. Starring Vincent Price & Carol Ohmart. A millionaire invites five people to a 'haunted house' party, and whoever makes it through the night earns $10,000.

programme.title: BFI: A Message From Mars
programme.desc: 1913. Sci-Fi. Director: J. Wallett Waller. The first silent British sci-fi feature (with new score). A Martian visits earth to cure a selfish man (similar to 'A Christmas Carol') on Christmas Eve.

programme.title: Law Of The Plainsman
programme.desc: 1960. A Matter Of Life and Death. Stars Michael Ansara, Jean Allison & Roberto Contreras. Sam Buckhart goes after an outlaw who's been reported as living in Albuquerque.

programme.title: A Lifetime Ago with The Baim Collection
programme.desc: York. 1972. Valentine Dyall tells us about York, an ancient city steeped in history. Whilst its outlook is to the next century, it retains the atmosphere of its heritage.

programme.title: Lily of Killarney
programme.desc: 1934. Set in Ireland, a poor Landowner's rival frames him for a murder. Stars John Garrick & Stanley Holloway is well suited to his semi-comic role as a baritone Father O'Flynn.

programme.title: Out of Town
programme.desc: Old Railway Line/Cloudburst at the Agricultural Show. 1981. Jack examines the flora and fauna along an abandoned railway line, then gets soaked while judging horses at the annual New Forest Show.

programme.title: What Every Woman Wants
programme.desc: 1954. Drama. Director: Maurice Elvey. Stars Brian Rix, Prunella Scales & Joan Sims. A newlywed couple with no home are forced to live with their parents and are never permitted a moment's privacy.

programme.title: The Marked One
programme.desc: 1963. Crime. Director: Francis Searle. Stars William Lucas, Zena Walker & Patrick Jordan. Criminals kidnap a man's daughter in order to obtain forgery plates which they believe he possesses.

programme.title: Dixon of Dock Green
programme.desc: Domino. 1976. Stars Jack Warner, Sally Faulkner & Michael Stainton. A friendly drink between a dock worker and a yacht owner ends with a gunshot, leading the police to deal with a complex case.

programme.title: Look At Life Ticket to Tokyo
programme.desc: 1959. A look at travelling from London with a Britannia Airline to Tokyo to discover Japan, and back via Hong Kong along with a look at the ocean liner Arundel Castle.

programme.title: The Big Job
programme.desc: 1965. Comedy. A gang of crooks are caught on a big job. 15 years later they find their loot is now buried under a police station. Stars Sidney James, Sylvia Syms, Dick Emery & Joan Sims.

programme.title: Magic Feet - Glimpses
programme.desc: Short documentary film about British football's 'star of stars', Sir Stanley Matthews

programme.title: A Good Read: Sherlock Holmes
programme.desc: The Resident Patient. Enjoy this classic short story read by Mike Read in which Blessington seeks help from Sherlock Holmes after discovering intruders have been in his bedroom.

programme.title: Rollercoaster - Glimpses
programme.desc: Experience the thrill of an early British rollercoaster first hand in this short film by John Seccombe.

programme.title: Champions
programme.desc: 1984. Drama. Directed by John Irvin. Stars John Hurt, Edward Woodward & Gregory Jones. The story of Bob Champion, a steeplechase jockey who was diagnosed with cancer at the height of his career.

programme.title: Tell Me Another
programme.desc: Colleagues, Past and Present, from the World of Showbusiness. 1976. Personal anecdotes as told to Dick Hills. This episode stars Michael Bentine, Bernard Cribbins and Jim Dale.

programme.title: The Riddle Of The Sands
programme.desc: 1978. Adventure. Director: Tony Maylam. Stars Michael York, Jenny Agutter & Simon MacCorkindale. Set in 1901, a pair of British yachtsmen discover a German plot to invade England.

programme.title: Cellar Club with Caroline Munro
programme.desc: Doom and dread join Caroline in the Cellar Club tonight, but there is plenty to enjoy. First up, is Doomwatch - The Web of Fear, about a strange outbreak of yellow fever plaguing the Scilly Isles.

programme.title: Doomwatch
programme.desc: The Web of Fear. 1971. Stars Simon Oates, Vivien Sherrard, Stephanie Bidmead. The Scilly Isles are quarantined following a mysterious outbreak of yellow fever. Doomwatch take on the investigation.

programme.title: Cellar Club with Caroline Munro
programme.desc: A terrifying murder mystery is up next, as Caroline Munro presents the 1939 feature The Dark Eyes of London starring horror legend Bela Lugosi and also featuring Greta Gynt and Hugh Williams.

programme.title: The Dark Eyes of London
programme.desc: 1939. Horror. Directed by Walter Summers. Stars Bela Lugosi & Hugh Williams. A series of drownings in the Thames starts Inspector Holt on the trail of one of London's most sinister murderers.

programme.title: Cellar Club with Caroline Munro
programme.desc: Join Caroline Munro for a sneak peek at next week's treats including another intriguing investigation and the rise of the living dead.

programme.title: The Big Combo
programme.desc: 1955. Crime. Director: Joseph H. Lewis. Stars Cornel Wilde & Jean Wallace. A police lieutenant, on a mission to bring down an elusive crime boss, targets the gangster's girlfriend to get her help.

programme.title: Up River
programme.desc: 1979. Drama. Murder, violence and greed haunt a young man's dream of forming a life from the untamed wilds of British Columbia at the turn of the century.

programme.title: Sky Liner
programme.desc: 1949. Thriller. Director: William Berke. Stars Richard Travis, Pamela Blake & Rochelle Hudson. An FBI Agent finds himself caught up in Cold War espionage when he boards a plane heading west.

programme.title: While I Live
programme.desc: 1947. Drama. (aka The Dream of Olwen) 25 years later, a spinster still obsesses over the death of her sister, who was a composer.

programme.title: It's All In A Lifetime
programme.desc: Charming amateur film from the 1940s onward, detailing the life of one couple. A real glimpse of time gone by.

programme.title: Date With Disaster
programme.desc: 1957. Crime Drama. Directed by Charles Saunders. Stars Tom Drake, William Hartnell & Shirley Eaton. Two owners of a car business plan a heist whilst their other business partner is away.

programme.title: The Roy Rogers Show
programme.desc: Blind Justice. 1952. Stars Roy Rogers, Trigger & Dale Evans. Newly discovered episode. An old prospector is robbed and blinded by an outlaw gang who will stop at nothing to find his mine.

programme.title: Space Patrol
programme.desc: Deadly Whirlwind. 1963. Stars Libby Morris, Ronnie Stevens & Murray Kash. Neptune deploys an artificial planet to alter the orbits of Earth, Mars and Venus. Can the team save the planets in time?

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: The Joker's Hard Times. 1967. Stars Adam West, Burt Ward & Alan Napier. The Joker continues with his zodiac theme as the Dynamic Duo pursue him!

programme.title: Richard the Lionheart
programme.desc: The Little People of Lyntor. 1963. Stars Dermot Walsh, Robin Hunter & Trader Faulkner. Richard finds out taxpayers have been tricked by false documents backed by Prince John's soldiers.

programme.title: Supercar
programme.desc: The Tracking of Masterspy. 1961. Stars David Graham, George Murcell, Graydon Gould. Masterspy attempts to steal the secrets of Supercar and Dr Beaker lets him take everything he wants.

programme.title: The Last Load
programme.desc: 1948. Family. Directed by John Baxter. Stars Douglas Barr, Ivor Bowyer & Angela Glynne. Two friends help out two sisters who suspect that someone is sabotaging their father's lorry business.

programme.title: The Adventures of Robin Hood
programme.desc: Betrothal. 1955. Betrothal. Stars Stars Richard Greene, Victor Woolf & Archie Duncan. Once again Sir Richard of the Lea has financial troubles due to his heavy gambling.

programme.title: Zontar - Thing From Venus
programme.desc: 1967. Sci-fi. Directed by Larry Buchanan. Stars John Agar, Susan Bjurman & Tony Huston. A young scientist believes an alien from Venus can help Earth but soon discovers it has a malevolent plan.

programme.title: Look At Life A Pinch of Salt
programme.desc: 1960. A look into the depths of Britain's only salt mine in Cheshire.

programme.title: One Step Beyond

programme.title: Mecha Builders

programme.title: Finny an Siorc

programme.title: Igam Ogam
